what: The section stays pinned to the screen (150vh by default) while the center panel (like a phone screen) sinks down 105% and the big headline above blurs out, then the side images gather from 10% of the outer column width to the center of each column and the caption beneath opens late — when gathering ends, a vertical center line is drawn. For a hero that splits two ways of use or two products

options.length: Fixed length (% of screen height), default 150
options.shift: Outer distance where the side images start (% of cell width), default 10 — 0 keeps them in place
options.sink: Distance the center panel drops (% of its own height), default 105
options.min: Fixed only at this width (px) or above, default 960 — when narrower, simply stacked as is
options.[data-fx-part=stage]: Panel to pin (child, or the element itself if none)
options.[data-fx-part=fade]: Large text that blurs — once fully blurred, the element gets is-faded (e.g. swapping a picture’s expression)
options.[data-fx-part=side]: Side images that gather (several) — start from the left if left of the cell center, from the right if right of it
options.[data-fx-part=line]: Center vertical line drawn when the gathering ends (optional)
